Hi Lauren / Sarah,

Thanks — great conversation. Quick answers inline: 

1) Drawdown cadence: GCP Private Offers can be configured for monthly or quarterly drawdown. Monthly drawdown is standard and is the simplest for consumption mapping; we can also set a quarterly cadence if requested by the buyer. Front-loading (e.g., taking larger drawdowns in Q1) is supported but needs explicit configuration in the private offer terms — we can add a schedule table.

2) PO / SKU mapping: We need the exact PO number to include in the invoice header so it surfaces in the customer's billing export. For the marketplace side, we will need the listing SKU and the internal billing SKU that Redwood wants to apply against the commit. Please provide the SKU IDs (if unknown we can look them up once you share the listing name).

Action items for us:
- I will open the private offer in our system and generate a DocuSign private offer envelope once you confirm the drawdown cadence and the final numbers.
- I attached the GCP private-offer checklist and the standard DocuSign workflow.

DocuSign link will be generated by Friday EOD once we have the PO number and SKU mapping.
